description: Agent pipeline funnel over Mastra's native trace spans for the Meeting Search Specialist — the product sub-agent the supervisor delegates every meeting question to, so this is the path real user traffic takes. How many agent runs reach the search tool, and how many of those reach the final generation. Conversion / drop-off per phase — observability that only makes sense for an agent. Steps match by service_name + span_name on the same trace, in temporal order. Span names verified against live production traces on 2026-07-25 (see README: the supervisor turn itself emits NO invoke_agent span, so it cannot be a funnel step).
